title: Add selectable training reward version 2 beside the frozen version 1
summary: locomotion.task_v2 implements reward version 2 from the Table I audit: command-scaled tracking (per-control kernel B or stride-mean kernel C), the Table I penalties and a TrainingTaskV2 that keeps each replica's previous raw action, previous joint velocity and velocity window, restarted at command changes and resets. task.py stays byte-identical, and train.py and prepare.py select version 2 only with --reward-version 2. Its defaults, kernel C with k 0.4 and calibrated penalties, are recorded as provisional pending review. Offline, version 2 reproduces the audited candidate scores and ranks both recorded walkers above standing still and both jittering policies.
next: The named reviewer confirms the kernel, k, command floors, yaw extension and penalty weights; a version 2 training run then needs the program lead's approval and matching standing admission.
reason: Version 1 remains the unchanged default and no training run used version 2, so no measured result, roadmap marker or gate changes.
